list: Official 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden on PlayStation. Names, descriptions and grades as published on PlayStation (Exophase / PSNProfiles, Nov 2026). Guides in our own words, each citing its source.

sources.list: Exophase / PSNProfiles via Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are yours — no multiplayer and no DLC are needed, since all 55 are single-player and offline. Expect a long road: PowerPyx rates the set 4/10 difficulty and about 200 hours, most of it the 100% checklist behind A Long Road. Work the roadmap in order and it arrives last, on its own.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when you finish Gone Fishing, the first main mission of Chapter 1, so just play the story. PowerPyx lists it as automatic and unmissable. If it has not popped, keep following the pink main-mission markers until the mission ends.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It pops when Chapter 1 ends, which PowerPyx places right after you start the first main mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag? Before you leave Chapter 1, do the one thing that might not come back: Lucia's balcony meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude).

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It pops when Chapter 2 ends, as the first main mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City, begins. Chapter 2 is where the game opens up: after the Coffee Break mission you can switch between Jason and Lucia and roam together, which most partner trophies need.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It pops once Chapter 3 is done, after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Chapter 3 unlocks several trophy systems — the Key Cloner, Yasmani's jewelry jobs and Randy's car wish list — so take the side quests as they appear.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It pops at the end of Chapter 4, after the final main mission of that chapter, Starting From Zero. By now the large bank-vault robberies are open (see Maximum Withdrawal), and free roam after the story keeps everything else reachable.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Gold story trophy, impossible to miss. It pops when you finish the final mission — the same mission that closes Chapter 4, Starting From Zero, in PowerPyx's walkthrough. Finishing the story also unlocks the 100% Completion Checklist (Progress, Stats, 100% Completion), the long grind behind the other gold, A Long Road.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It pops during Chapter 2 when you complete the main mission Breakfast Run. There is no mission replay and no gold-medal requirement, so play it however you like; the trophy is awarded for finishing the mission, not for how you finish it.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It pops during Chapter 3 when you complete the main mission The Cartel Heist. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter — PowerPyx recommends saves at the start and end of every chapter, since there is no mission replay to fall back on.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It pops during Chapter 4 when you complete the main mission Child's Play. Story trophies like this one need no special route: follow the main missions and they unlock in order, one after another, through the five chapters.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It pops during Chapter 4 when you complete the main mission Headliners. If you are hunting efficiently, use the downtime between story missions to scan new vehicles with the WAiNK app and study animals with binoculars — both count toward the 100% checklist later.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It pops during Chapter 4 when you complete the main mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. The airport returns later for Catch Me If You Can, where you steal a docked passenger plane — a separate, free-roam trophy, not this story one.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It pops during Chapter 5 when you complete the main mission Operation Savage Glory. PowerPyx's walkthrough treats the story as five chapters taking roughly 60–80 hours, with free roam continuing after the credits for everything that remains.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Gold for finishing the 35-item 100% checklist (Progress, Stats, 100% Completion), which only becomes viewable after the story — though progress made during the story already counts. PowerPyx stresses it is lenient, closer to 60% true completion: most items need only part of a set, e.g. 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 of 397 stunts. Nothing on it is missable.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. Mix categories freely — PowerPyx calls under-the-bridge flights the quickest. Track them on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots, or Progress, Activities, Stunts. The 100% checklist later wants 300, so keep going past 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race (car, race challenge or drone race) and performing a stunt. Check Touchpad, Progress, Activities to see which types you have done. PowerPyx notes most come naturally from the story and the other trophies, so this usually pops on its own.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. PowerPyx's guide links a full location-and-gold walkthrough for every range, and notes the golds are not too difficult. The same 42 golds are required for the 100% checklist, so this silver and A Long Road share the work — practise one range at a time.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations — 42 drone races in total, since each location hosts several. PowerPyx publishes a location guide for all 14 spots, and the 100% checklist also requires all 42 drone time trials, so the two goals overlap completely. Learn one course, then move to the next location.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race location counts once, so repeat wins at the same spot do not help. PowerPyx lists 40 unique race locations, giving you twice as many chances as you need, and the 100% checklist wants 30 wins. Pick the short, easy courses first and work through the map markers.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you and mark a fishing spot with a purple icon. Follow Cal's fishing questline and beat him in a fishing challenge. PowerPyx's guide shows the challenge in pictures; fishing also counts toward the 9 activity types for Master of None.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish all levels of any one of the 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind or Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end — bonus challenges are not required.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's questline is Lucia-only and starts in Chapter 3, when Andy calls and texts her home address in Belville. Finish her 5 quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops at the last one. PowerPyx confirms all her quests stay available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline starts in Chapter 1, a while after the mission Island Dreams, when he calls and is marked KR in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — find each chest with the metal detector and bring it back. Track it under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees. He goes quiet for a while, then returns in Chapters 2–3; nothing here is missable.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Finish his 5 quests — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes — and the trophy pops at the last. PowerPyx confirms all of them stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger strands — but note that not every side questline counts: PowerPyx says Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count toward this trophy. Confirmed counters include Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm) and Yago (street racing), plus Pilot Pete's delivery chain. All strangers remain available in free roam after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal a Zorrusso for him using the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City (green RK icon). Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check the list, steal them — they cluster around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach — and deliver them in good condition for more pay.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's questline is Jason-only and opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, with purple Synthetic Lab markers in Vice City. Destroy enough labs in the Take Out Kitty Litter quest, then Tyrone gives you Spin On This — shut the labs down — and the trophy pops when it is done. PowerPyx confirms it all stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: ⚠ THE ONLY POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY. Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations; each spot counts +2 if both Jason and Lucia meditate there. The risk is Chapter 1: after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she will meditate, walks to the balcony, and you must follow and choose Accept. That balcony meditation vanishes after Chapter 1, and PowerPyx says it is still unconfirmed whether it is required — do it anyway, before Chapter 1 ends.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's questline is Jason-only and starts after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Bret texts Jason and marks Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. Do that first quest, then Bret marks hunting spots with purple icons: hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. He gives you the Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle; one clean shot keeps the animal pristine and pays more. All 15 Target Decks are also needed for 100%.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets scattered across Leonida. PowerPyx publishes a guide to all 18 set locations; you only need 3 sets for this silver, so pick the sets whose cards cluster together and grab them in one route. The 100% checklist wants 15 of 18 sets, so keep collecting past the trophy.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan any 100 WAiNK locations with the phone app — hold Up then R1 while looking at a scannable object. PowerPyx breaks the set down as 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags, with well over 100 in the world, so any 100 count. The 100% checklist also requires exactly 100, so this silver lands together with that goal.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges, tracked under Progress, Challenges. PowerPyx notes many complete naturally while you work on the other trophies, and the 100% checklist needs 70 of 80 — so this bronze pops automatically on the way there. Leave it for late, then pick the easiest unfinished challenges from the list.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: First unlock duo free roam after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, then call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle). Build a 4-star wanted level, then escape the red heat zone — PowerPyx recommends a fast sports bike through traffic, or the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops and helicopters struggle to follow. It also pops naturally during the bank-vault robberies in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you (duo free roam from Chapter 2's Coffee Break), rob 3 shops in a row while the wanted level never drops — keep the flashing red/blue wanted state alive between shops. PowerPyx advises armour, sticky bombs and healing items, and suggests the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, open after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. The pop is delayed about half a minute after the third shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app (hold Up to open it, look at a vehicle, hold R1) — you do not need to drive them. PowerPyx says the game has 557 vehicles at launch and suggests standing on a busy road and scanning everything that passes. The 100% checklist needs 200 base-model scans, so this bronze comes automatically on that route.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Trigger Combat Focus with L3+R3 while aiming, then drop 5 enemies before the purple focus bar runs out. PowerPyx advises topping up focus first (food, drinks, a wash or shower, Adrenaline to extend it), wearing body armour, and using a full-auto rifle such as the Duke 556 at a gang operation, where enemies cluster. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus level rises with shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA — planes parked out on the airfield do not count. PowerPyx points to the easiest one at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off. Fly at least 1 km from the airport and the trophy pops, slightly delayed.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (a Rhino) at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — the tanks stand in the south of the base. PowerPyx says to drive through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in, and shoot enemies until the trophy pops. Expect heavy resistance on the way in and out.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and jewelry robberies themselves. Then slip into a jewelry store through the back door with the Snap Gun (do not kick the door, which trips the alarm), find the note with the safe code in the back room, and loot the safe unseen. PowerPyx recommends Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape. They open with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to carry a second bag of cash. After that, buy van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 a tip. Each vault pays up to $205,000 and triggers a 4-star wanted level, so escape fast.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Robbing a bank vault in the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… counts as robbing an armored truck, so this usually pops with Maximum Withdrawal. To get it earlier, PowerPyx says to block an armored truck near a bank, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius — sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the map — all 52 areas of Leonida. PowerPyx recommends doing it by plane: fly over every black-fogged patch until the whole map is visible, and it links a guide to the fastest plane for the job. Exploring also reveals activity, robbery and collectible markers, so do this before the big cleanup stages.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — there are 39 operations in total, marked with yellow icons as you approach them. Track each gang under Progress, Gangs. The 100% checklist requires all 39, so this bronze pops on the way to A Long Road. PowerPyx publishes a full location guide for every operation.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method yet at launch — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, and the official description is the only hint: enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to a bar or venue overlooking Ocean Beach and order a cocktail; it may pop during normal play. Do not chase a specific spot until a guide confirms one — this entry will be updated when the method is verified.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window — only that specific blue Banshee counts, says PowerPyx, as a nod to the Banshee from GTA III. You need the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS. The pop is slightly delayed, after you drive away down the street.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: At Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — a Kolt gang operation, first visited in the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling — steal all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on a table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation). The trophy pops after you escape the police, and the valuables can be collected across repeat visits.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time — check Touchpad, Jason & Lucia, Strength (heart icon). Duo free roam unlocks after Chapter 2's Coffee Break; always train together, since the partner completes training automatically while the other works out. Buy a fitness-club membership (filter the map by Activities, dumbbell icon) and grind both characters to max.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile — the trophy list itself shows your count out of 500. Turn on profile notifications (Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile) so a demon-face icon flags each qualifying action. Stealthy robberies and clean escapes build the Professional side; killing builds Violent, Psycho and, if pushed too far, the permanent Irredeemable status. It mostly completes passively during robberies and the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method yet at launch — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. The description, Second time's the charm, suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something that first failed. Treat it as a trophy that may pop during normal play, and do not chase an unverified method.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg: go alone, at night after 2 AM, to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County. If a blinking car is parked at the roadside, follow the path into the woods to find the UFO's bright blue light; if the car is not there, drive away and come back, since the spawn is slightly random. Approach the UFO, it drops an abducted woman — talk to her, offer help, and return to her car to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method yet at launch — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle, i.e. a melee drive-by. The description suggests knocking someone over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Try melee kicks from a bike at slow speed near pedestrians in open ground, and treat it as unconfirmed until a guide verifies the exact trigger.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills in total — it counts across robberies, not in one trip. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and payday loans and carry the marked bills to a fence; PowerPyx says Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. Bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 each, so this comes naturally with the robbery cleanup.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shop types — guns, car mods, tattoos, clothes, hair, electronics and more. PowerPyx says the fastest route is the expensive stuff: weapons at the 24 Ammu-Nations, vehicle mods at the 14 mod shops, and tattoos. Normal shopping during the story and the garage-buying grind covers much of it, so it usually pops without farming.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages — the 4 story garages do not count — for $160,000 in total, through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone. The app appears after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses). PowerPyx links a guide to all 12 garage locations. Robberies in Chapters 3–4 are the fastest way to fund the purchases.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app, which installs on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses). First buy enough garages (see Little Boxes), since each garage adds parking spots. Then drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray and Register — or, from Chapter 3, register tracker cars at any Pay 'n' Spray. Use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep costs down.
